class.name: RichTextEditToolbar
class.brief_description: Toolbar with common formatting controls for [RichTextEdit].
class.description: [RichTextEditToolbar] provides common formatting controls for a [RichTextEdit]. It includes controls for bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, overline, font size, foreground color, background color, outline color and width, quote blocks, alignment, indentation, URL links, lists, image insertion, and CSS-compatible line height. Use [member two_row_layout] to fold the controls onto two rows when the toolbar has to fit a narrow container. Assign [member rich_text_edit_path] to the [RichTextEdit] to format. If the path is empty, the toolbar looks for a sibling [RichTextEdit] when it enters the scene tree. The controls follow the target editor's caret position: the font size field shows the size at the caret, and the formatting toggles, the list buttons and the alignment dropdown show the formatting that is already applied there. The three color buttons each open a [ColorPicker]. The font and background color buttons preview the color on the selection while the picker is open and commit the final color as a single undoable formatting action when the popup closes. The background color button starts out with no color, and its picker is headed by a [b]No Color[/b] row that returns to that state. Applying an empty URL in the link dropdown removes the link from the selection. The image button opens a [FileDialog] using the native system picker when available. Project-local images are stored as [code]res://[/code] paths; external images keep their absolute path and are not copied into the project. Newly inserted images use their original size and an empty alt text. The existing link dropdown also applies a URL to a selected image. The line-height dropdown applies the chosen CSS [code]normal[/code], unitless, percentage, or [code]px[/code] value to every paragraph touched by the selection. It provides common presets and a custom input field. Adjusting a number field's spinner arrows repeatedly, or dragging the outline color picker, collapses the whole burst into a single undo step. Editing anything else, retargeting the selection, or moving the caret starts a new one. [codeblock] # Scene tree: # VBoxContainer # RichTextEditToolbar # RichTextEdit # # If both nodes are siblings, RichTextEditToolbar can find RichTextEdit automatically. [/codeblock]

method.name: get_rich_text_edit
method.description: Returns the [RichTextEdit] currently controlled by this toolbar, or [code]null[/code] if no target is available.

members.member: Path to the [RichTextEdit] controlled by this toolbar. Leave this empty to use the first sibling [RichTextEdit] found in the scene tree.

If [code]true[/code], the controls are laid out on two rows instead of one: the first row holds the character formatting, font size, and the font, background and outline color controls, and the second row holds the horizontal rule, quote, alignment, indentation, list, link, image and line-height controls. The toolbar becomes narrower and twice as tall. Can be changed at any time, including at run time.
